item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 10/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to bring cold weather to southern China today. With a dry continental airstream affecting Guangdong during the Lunar New Year holidays, the weather will be generally fine over the region. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. A relatively humid easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be misty over the region.

Date/Month: 10/02 (Saturday)
Wind: North to northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Cold. Cloudy with one or two rain patches in the morning. Becoming fine during the day.
Temp range: 12 - 18 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
